author: Krrish
body:
Hello my name is incognitoGaming
-I was banned for speed,killaura.and xray
-I'm not going to go into denial and say my ban was false
-I have waited probably a month and a half.

I should be unbanned becuase i had to literally reboot my computer to get rid of the mod and I really want to make a youtube channel and I'm banned so unable to do that. Also Because i read the "appealing an infraction document" and it says I'm allowed on the server 1 more time. In other words i get a second chance,unless i'm caught again and results in a perm ban.

title: Ban for hacking

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

Since you have only waited a short period of time, you will not be unbanned. In order to appeal a ban for hacking, you must wait much longer than you have now.

Regards,
MidnightBeats
